title: The Islands That Might Be Like Ours

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A navigator wonders whether there might be other islands with villages much like Isola.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a navigator, wonders whether there might be other islands with villages much like Isola.

choices.label: Ask What Would Be the Same.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villagers imagine another island with its own fishers, gardens and festivals.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A child imagines another child on another island wondering the same thing.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar wonders whether some islands might have no people at all.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A storyteller imagines islands of ice and fire.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village decides that laughter and love would be the same anywhere.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: An elder says nobody can know, and that is part of the wonder.
